This Miscellaneous Second appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 12.09.2018 in L.A.C.(Appeal) No.174/2016 passed by Principal District judge at Hassan, and judgment and award dated 16.12.2011 in LAC.No.82/2010 passed by the Senior Civil Judge at Holenarasipura, seeking enhancement of compensation.
2.

Learned counsel appearing for the appellant submits that in respect of the similar acquisition, in the connected matters already the order of the Reference Court is set aside and the matters are remanded back to the Reference Court for fresh consideration.
While remanding the matter, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court had permitted the appellant to make the beneficiary as a party before the Reference Court.

Considering the order passed by the Co-ordinate bench of this Court in M.S.A. No.68/2023 arising out of the very same land acquisition proceedings, this Court is passing the following:
ORDER

(i) The order of the First Appellate Court dated 12.09.2018 passed in L.A.C.(Appeal)
No.174/2016 by the Court of the Principal District Judge at Hassan, is set-aside and the matter is remanded to the Reference Court for fresh disposal in accordance with law.

entities.text: Court of the Principal District Judge at Hassan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (ii) The beneficiary herein shall be made as a party before the Reference Court.
(iii) Liberty is reserved to both the parties to adduce evidence in further if they are so advised, either oral, documentary or both.

(iv) All the parties shall appear before the Reference Court on 03.04.2025 without further notice and the Reference Court shall decide the case and pass appropriate orders within a period of six months from thereon.
